body.p: Reconsideration of the above-identified application in view of the present Amendment is respectfully requested.

Claims 1-15 were pending in the application. By this paper, without acquiescing in the grounds for rejection and for expediting prosecution, claim 12 has been amended. Claims 1-11 have been cancelled, and new claims 16-31 have been added. No new matter has been added by the present amendment.

Original claims 1-11 have been cancelled. Independent claim 12 has been amended in accordance with the Examiner's suggestion on page 2, paragraph 2, of the Non-Final Office Action. More specifically, the term "the at least one non-retractable wheel-type landing gear" was added to amended claim 12 for the purpose of clarity as suggested by the Examiner. Original claims 13-15 remain unchanged. Furthermore, new claims 16-24 have been added based on original claims 2, and 4-11, respectively, and new claims 25-31 have been added based on original claims 12, 13, 14-15, 16, 17, 18-19, and 20, respectively. Please note that no new matter has been added by the present amendment.
Claims 5, 6 and 12 were objected to because of certain informalities.

Without acquiescing in the Patent Office's grounds of objection, and solely for the purpose of expediting prosecution, claims 5 and 6 have been cancelled and claim 12 has been amended with the objections in mind and as suggested by the Examiner.
Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of the objections to the claims.
Claims 1, 2 and 7 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. §102 as being anticipated by U.S. Publication No. 2023/0278701 to Brand, hereinafter Brand; and

claims 3-6 and 8-11 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 as being obvious over Brand, as applied to claim 1 above, and further in view of U.S. Publication No. 2006/0237584 to Hinton, hereinafter Hinton.
Applicant respectfully traverses these rejections for at least the following reasons.

At the outset, Applicant notes the indication on page 9 of the Office Action of the allowance of claims 12-15. Applicant thanks the Patent Office for favorable review of these claims. Without acquiescing in the grounds for rejection, and for expediting prosecution Applicant has i) cancelled claims 1-11; ii) amended independent claim 12 to overcome the objection as suggested by the Examiner; and vi) added new claims 16-24 to depend from allowable claim 12.
Accordingly, independent claim 12 is allowed, as indicated on page 9 of the Office Action.

Claims 13-24 all depend either directly or indirectly from claim 12, and are therefore allowable for at least the same reasons as claim 12. Moreover, these claims add further limitations that also render them separately allowable.
Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the rejection of these claims.

New claim 16-24 depends from allowed claim 12, and are therefore allowable for at least the same reasons as claim 12. Moreover, these claims add further limitations that also renders them separately allowable.
New claim 25 includes similar limitations as allowed independent claim 12 is and are therefore allowable for at least similar reasons as claim 12.

Claims 26-31 all depend either directly or indirectly from claim 25, and are therefore allowable for at least the same reasons as claim 25. Moreover, these claims add further limitations that also render them separately allowable.

It is believed that all of the stated grounds of rejection have been properly traversed, accommodated, or rendered moot. Applicant therefore respectfully requests that the Patent Office reconsider and withdraw all presently outstanding rejections. It is believed that a full and complete response has been made to the outstanding Office Action and that the present application is in condition for allowance. Thus, prompt and favorable consideration of this amendment is respectfully requested. By addressing particular positions taken by the Patent Office in the above remarks, Applicant does not acquiesce to other positions that have not been explicitly addressed. In addition, Applicant's arguments for the patentability of a claim should not be understood as implying that no other reasons exist for the patentability of that claim.

Applicant submits that the claims are in a condition for allowance and respectfully request a notice to that effect. If the Patent Office believes that a discussion or a claim amendment of a minor nature would advance the prosecution of this application, the Patent Office is highly encouraged to telephone the Applicant's attorney at the number given below.

Applicant believes no fees to be due in connection with the filing of this paper. However, the Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any fees or credit any overpayments as a result of the filing of this paper to our Deposit Account No. 02-3978.
Respectfully submitted,
